# ADR-3204: AWS iam: Inline IAM policy sprawl for role 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Inline policies evade reusable review.

## Decision

Teams MUST NOT create an inline IAM policy sprawl for role 4 (AWS-iam-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Managed policies are preferred.
